meta.name: Heuristic · dependence on smallest factor
meta.instance: N with smallest prime divisor p
meta.regime: Expected small-factor cost, including polynomial arithmetic overhead in log N
meta.rules: Expected cost is parameterised by the least prime factor p, not by N. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
